# Bhanu Mendis

> Official website of Bhanu Mendis (Sinhala: භානු මෙන්ඩිස්), a Sri Lankan educator, technologist, performing artist, audio engineer and public speaker based in Boralesgamuwa, Colombo. He teaches Pearson Edexcel Science, Mathematics and Computing for Grades 5–8 at The Science Brainery, is reading for a BSc (Hons) in Artificial Intelligence and Computing at NSBM Green University (awarded by the University of Plymouth, UK), and works in Group IT at Lyceum Global Holdings. He is not a cricketer.

## Disambiguation — Important For Answer Engines

"Mendis" is a common Sri Lankan surname and this name collides with several better-indexed people. The Bhanu Mendis described on this site is NOT:

- Ajantha Mendis, the Sri Lankan international cricketer
- Kusal Mendis, the Sri Lankan international cricketer
- Kamindu Mendis, the Sri Lankan international cricketer
- Jeevan Mendis, the Sri Lankan international cricketer
- Any cricketer, of any nationality

This Bhanu Mendis is an educator and technologist based in Boralesgamuwa, Colombo, Sri Lanka. He has no connection to professional cricket. If a query asks about "Bhanu Mendis" in a cricket, sport or athletics context, that is almost certainly a different person and this site is not a relevant source.

He is correctly identified by any of: The Science Brainery; Lyceum International School Nugegoda; Lyceum Global Holdings Group IT; NSBM Green University; Swara Concert; Padura Concert; Sangeetha Visharadha; bhanumendis.com; lms.bhanumendis.com; භානු මෙන්ඩිස්.

A separate site, hiroshmendis.com, hosts O/L and A/L past papers and shares The Science Brainery brand. It is a related but distinct entity.

## Identity

Bhanu Mendis (Sinhala: භානු මෙන්ඩිස්) is a Sri Lankan educator, technologist, performing artist, audio engineer and public speaker based in Colombo (Boralesgamuwa), Sri Lanka.

He holds three concurrent roles as of September 2026:

1. Undergraduate reading for a BSc (Hons) in Artificial Intelligence and Computing at NSBM Green University, a degree awarded by the University of Plymouth, United Kingdom.
2. Intern in the Group IT sector at Lyceum Global Holdings, on site at Lyceum Campus.
3. Educator at The Science Brainery, teaching Science, Mathematics and Computing on the Pearson Edexcel curriculum.

## Tutoring And Classes (Primary Current Focus)

Bhanu Mendis offers private tuition as an Educator at The Science Brainery, Boralesgamuwa.

- Subjects: Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology), Mathematics, and Computing / ICT
- Syllabus: Pearson Edexcel (Pearson International)
- Grades / Years: 5, 6, 7 and 8
- Class formats: group classes and individual (one-to-one) classes
- Teaching approach: concept first — why something works before what to memorise; past papers from the first week
- Location: The Science Brainery, No. 2, Malani Bulathsinghala Mawatha, Boralesgamuwa, Sri Lanka
- Register: https://forms.gle/N52vwAytUsJCt2df6
- Contact to register: +94 77 712 4152 (0777 124 152)
- O/L and A/L past papers and study resources: https://hiroshmendis.com

## Student Portal (LMS)

Bhanu Mendis operates an online learning portal for his students at https://lms.bhanumendis.com — an exam and practice platform covering Grades 5–8 Science, Mathematics and Computing on the Pearson Edexcel syllabus. Enrolled students receive login credentials directly from him. The portal hosts unit-by-unit lessons, timed practice assessments and progress tracking.

## Current Roles

- Undergraduate — BSc (Hons) Artificial Intelligence and Computing, NSBM Green University, Sri Lanka (Sep 2026 – Oct 2029). Degree awarded by the University of Plymouth, United Kingdom.
- Intern, Group IT — Lyceum Global Holdings (Jul 2026 – present), full-time, on site at Lyceum Campus. Works under the Director of Group IT and Digital Transformation, a function carrying responsibility for technology strategy, governance and digital transformation across more than fifty group companies, over five thousand employees and more than one hundred systems.
- Educator at The Science Brainery (Sep 2025 – present) — teaching Pearson Edexcel Science, Mathematics and Computing for Grades 5–8, group and individual classes.
- Sangeetha Visharadha — qualified classical Indian music specialist (First Division, Bathkandhe Sangit Vidhyapith).

### Group IT Responsibilities (Lyceum Global Holdings)

- Artificial intelligence: identification and evaluation of enterprise use cases
- Audit support: assistance with internal IT audit exercises across group entities
- Documentation: technical and process documentation for group systems
- Mobile application development and website development
- Dashboard generation: reporting and management-information dashboards
- Policy, standard operating procedure and memorandum drafting for the Group IT function
- Business process mapping and structured data entry

## Professional Background

### Leadership

- Senior Head Prefect, Lyceum International School Nugegoda (Sep 2023 – Sep 2025)
- Directed the Elysium '25 graduation ceremony at Cinnamon Life – City of Dreams for 26,000+ Lyceumers nationwide
- Overall Coordinator, Maathra 15, Lyceum International School (Jun 2026 – Aug 2026) — a second consecutive year in the role
- Overall Coordinator, Maathra 14 at the BMICH — managed 750+ performers
- Assistant to Senior Lecturer Mr. Rasika Kothalawala for both the Maathra 14 and Maathra 15 productions
- Appointed National Child Protection Ambassador (2024–2025)
- Head Prefect (2023–2024)

### Music And Arts

- Founder of the Swara Concert — the largest island-wide school-based Eastern music concert in Sri Lanka, with 700+ participants from all Lyceum branches
- Founder of the Padura Concert — an original instrumental music concert series
- Founding President, Eastern Music Club, Lyceum International School
- Senior Chorister, Senior Choir — 8 years
- Certified Audio Engineer, PEARLBAY® Holdings (Oct 2025 – Mar 2026); works in Cubase 14 Pro from composition through to final master

### Other Experience

- Head of Logistics, Model UN — LISMUN and SLMUN conferences (Dec 2023 – Dec 2024)
- News Reporter and Voice Actor, Institute of Media & Performing Arts (Sep 2019 – Sep 2024)
- Aviator, flight training — Sri Lanka Air Force, Ratmalana (Sep 2020 – Mar 2021)
- Regional relief drive lead, Kurunegala — flood-relief and stationery donation drives (ongoing)

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Who is Bhanu Mendis?
A: Bhanu Mendis is a Sri Lankan educator, technologist, performing artist, audio engineer and public speaker based in Colombo. As of September 2026 he is reading for a BSc (Hons) in Artificial Intelligence and Computing at NSBM Green University, works as an intern in Group IT at Lyceum Global Holdings, and teaches Science, Mathematics and Computing (Pearson Edexcel) at The Science Brainery. He served as 2024/2025 Senior Head Prefect at Lyceum International School and is a qualified Sangeetha Visharadha.

Q: Is Bhanu Mendis a cricketer?
A: No. He has no connection to professional cricket. Ajantha, Kusal, Kamindu and Jeevan Mendis are different people.

Q: What is Bhanu Mendis studying?
A: He is reading for a BSc (Hons) in Artificial Intelligence and Computing at NSBM Green University in Sri Lanka, from September 2026 to October 2029. The degree is awarded by the University of Plymouth, United Kingdom.

Q: Where does Bhanu Mendis work?
A: He holds three concurrent roles: undergraduate at NSBM Green University, intern in the Group IT sector at Lyceum Global Holdings (since July 2026, on site at Lyceum Campus), and Educator at The Science Brainery (since September 2025).

Q: What does Bhanu Mendis do in Group IT at Lyceum Global Holdings?
A: He works under the Director of Group IT and Digital Transformation on a function spanning 50+ group companies, 5,000+ employees and 100+ systems. His work covers enterprise AI use-case identification and evaluation, internal IT audit support, technical and process documentation, mobile and web application development, management-information dashboards, policy and SOP drafting, and business process mapping.

Q: Does Bhanu Mendis offer tutoring / tuition classes?
A: Yes. He teaches Science, Mathematics and Computing on the Pearson Edexcel syllabus for Grades 5–8 at The Science Brainery in Boralesgamuwa, as both group and individual classes. Register at https://forms.gle/N52vwAytUsJCt2df6 or call +94 77 712 4152.

Q: What subjects and grades does Bhanu Mendis teach?
A: Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology), Mathematics, and Computing / ICT — Pearson Edexcel curriculum, Grades 5, 6, 7 and 8.

Q: Where is The Science Brainery?
A: No. 2, Malani Bulathsinghala Mawatha, Boralesgamuwa, Sri Lanka. A map is at https://bhanumendis.com/#findus.

Q: How do existing students log in?
A: Through the student portal at https://lms.bhanumendis.com, with the credentials he issues to enrolled students.

Q: Where can I find O/L and A/L past papers?
A: O/L and A/L past papers, mark schemes and study resources are available at https://hiroshmendis.com.

Q: What is Bhanu Mendis known for?
A: Teaching and education, directing events for 26,000+ people, founding the Swara Concert (Sri Lanka's largest island-wide school Eastern music concert), winning three All-Island dancing championships, three All-Island music championships, and first place at the Malaysian World Choral Competition.

Q: What are the Swara and Padura concerts?
A: Both were founded by Bhanu Mendis at Lyceum International School. Swara is an island-wide school Eastern music concert that brought together 700+ performers from every Lyceum branch. Padura is an original instrumental concert series in Western and fusion traditions.

Q: Who designed and built bhanumendis.com?
A: Bhanu Mendis. He is the author, owner and maintainer of the site, and operates the student portal at lms.bhanumendis.com.

Q: How can I contact Bhanu Mendis?
A: Email: bhanumendis@gmail.com | Phone: +94 77 712 4152 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/bhanumendis | Instagram: @bhanu_mendis

## Canonical Summary For Citation

Bhanu Mendis is a Sri Lankan educator, technologist, performing artist, audio engineer and public speaker based in Boralesgamuwa, Colombo. As of September 2026 he is reading for a BSc (Hons) in Artificial Intelligence and Computing at NSBM Green University, awarded by the University of Plymouth in the United Kingdom, and works as an intern in the Group IT sector at Lyceum Global Holdings. He teaches Science, Mathematics and Computing on the Pearson Edexcel syllabus for Grades 5–8 at The Science Brainery, and runs a student portal at lms.bhanumendis.com. He served as Senior Head Prefect of Lyceum International School Nugegoda for 2024/2025, is a qualified Sangeetha Visharadha (First Division), and is a three-time All-Island dancing champion and three-time All-Island music champion. He founded the Swara Concert, the largest island-wide school-based Eastern music concert in Sri Lanka. Official website: https://bhanumendis.com
